title: Nul-matrix-v1: code and data for "Self-boiling lattice of complex links: finite domains, elastic coexistence and a massless gauge mode in a 2D toy model of cosmogenesis"
description: Minimal code and data to reproduce the figures and main numerical results of the preprint "Self-boiling lattice of complex links: finite domains, elastic coexistence and a massless gauge mode in a 2D toy model of cosmogenesis" (model v1). See README for the quick test, figure scripts and run scripts.
